text:
alex_dev: kicking off region slow-burn rollout now — US -> EU -> APAC, 5% canary slices per region. deploying v2.14.3 to serving pool.

deploy-bot: Canary start: v2.14.3 @ us-central (slice=5%, instances=12). Logs: https://deploy.redwood/v/2601234567/us

maria_prodops: quick capacity question — do we have warm pool headroom in APAC for a gradual 5->20% over 30m? last check looked tight.

jon_sre: APAC warm pool currently 62% occupied, thermal headroom limited on gpus in ap-southeast1. if we push >10% we risk queueing. watching GPU queue > 300ms now.

liz_release: ok hold for APAC then. we can proceed US and EU as planned, gate APAC until we either increase warm pool or shift to smaller instance family.

alex_dev: agreed. US proceed. EU start now (slice=5%). APAC: holdpoint at 10:00 UTC for decision.

deploy-bot: Canary start: v2.14.3 @ eu-west (slice=5%, instances=10).

sam_support: heads up — a customer in EU reported a 2xx -> 5xx spike in the last canary earlier today on a similar rollout; error pattern = kv-cache misroute. keep an eye on 5xx rates.

jon_sre: adding rollback triggers to the deploy monitor:
```
- rollback if error_rate_5xx > 1.5% over 5m
- rollback if p95_latency > 600ms over 5m
- rollback if gpu_queue_time > 500ms for 3m
```

maria_prodops: can we pin EU traffic to v2.13.x for some high-traffic customers until we get more confidence? we should be able to route by tenant.

liz_release: yes — we can route via rollout rules. alex, please post the curl to pin; i'll update release notes accordingly.

alex_dev: pin command:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/rollouts/pin \n -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_TOKEN" \n -d '{"region":"eu-west","tenant_id":"@bigbank","version":"v2.13.9"}'
```

alex_dev: also enabling fallback model variant for APAC in case of capacity issues: fallback_model=redwood/mantic-1-4q8 (lower mem) — traffic routed automatically if queueing triggers exceed thresholds.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics (US): error_rate_5xx=0.2%, p95_latency=280ms, gpu_queue=80ms. EU metrics initial: error_rate_5xx=0.1%, p95_latency=310ms, gpu_queue=120ms.

jon_sre: EU looks fine. APAC still constrained — maria please confirm whether we want to increase warm pool by spinning additional warm instances (cost) or hold the APAC slice.

maria_prodops: cost vs risk: suggest hold APAC. we'll schedule a short warmup (extra 8 instances) at 11:30 UTC if no regressions in EU for 45m.

sam_support: thumbs up from support — if we need to pin any enterprise tenants to v2.13.9, ping me and i'll coordinate comms.

liz_release: release notes draft updated with rollback triggers, pin guidance, and APAC slow-burn note: https://notes.redwood/releases/v2.14.3 (added changelog and fallback model section).

alex_dev: running an abbreviated smoke test on EU with the canary traffic pattern generator. will report back in 10m.

jon_sre: reminder — if we trigger fallback_model in APAC, telemetry will show model_variant tag = "4q8-fallback". set dashboard alert for that.

deploy-bot: Canary check-in @ +12m: US OK, EU OK, APAC held. Next holdpoint 2601238167 (10:00 UTC) for APAC decision.

liz_release: thanks all — holding APAC, US/EU proceeding. follow-up doc in #eng-releases with final gating decision. :white_check_mark:
